payload.name: Cadencz
payload.description: 规划和安排社交媒体帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cadencz is a social media manager for founders and small teams: it plans, writes and schedules social media posts for your business. Connect your Cadencz account and ask ChatGPT to plan your week of posts, draft a post for LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky and more, show this week's content plan, or check how much of your plan you have used. Every post is grounded in what Cadencz learned about your business from your website and written in your own voice. Drafts are saved to your Cadencz workspace for review; nothing is published or scheduled without your confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Cadencz是创始人和小团队的社交媒体管理工具：它为您的企业规划、撰写并安排社交媒体帖子。连接您的Cadencz账户，让ChatGPT帮您规划一周的帖子，为领英、X、Threads、Bluesky等平台撰写内容，展示本周的内容计划，或查看您已使用计划的百分比。每篇帖子都基于Cadencz从您的网站中了解的业务信息，并以您自己的语气撰写。草稿会保存到您的Cadencz工作区以供审阅；未经您的确认，不会发布或安排任何内容。

payload.name: Infobip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get guidance on customer messaging implementation choices and best practices, including requirements by country and channel. Send with Infobip, then track trends in volume, delivery, costs, errors, and engagement metrics.
payload.longDescription: 获取客户消息实施选择和最佳实践的指导，包括各国和渠道的要求。通过Infobip发送，然后跟踪数量、交付、成本、错误和参与度指标的趋势。

payload.name: MBX Reach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MBX Reach is an email marketing tool for creators, brands, shops and growing teams: newsletters, email campaigns, contacts and mailing lists. Connect it and ask in plain words: ChatGPT looks people up in your audience, adds the people who asked to hear from you, tags them and puts them on mailing lists, writes email campaign drafts in your brand's design, checks whether a draft is ready to go, and reads your campaign reports (opens and clicks). ChatGPT never sends: every draft waits in MBX Reach until you review it and press Send. There is no tool to delete anything.
payload.longDescription: MBX Reach是创作者、品牌、店铺和成长型团队的电子邮件营销工具：新闻通讯、电子邮件活动、联系人和邮件列表。连接它并用简单明了的语言提问：ChatGPT会查找受众中的人员，将那些希望收到你消息的人添加进来，打标签并将其加入邮件列表，按照品牌设计撰写电子邮件活动草稿，检查草稿是否准备就绪，并阅读您的活动报告（打开和点击情况）。ChatGPT从不自动发送：每个草稿都会在MBX Reach中等待，直到您审查并点击发送。没有删除任何内容的工具。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find contacts and see their lists and tags, Add people who asked to join and put them on lists, Write and edit campaign drafts (never sends), Check whether a draft is ready and read campaign reports

payload.name: InboxFamily
payload.description: 家庭邮箱，源自您的聊天
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InboxFamily gives a family email addresses on its own domain. This plugin works with an existing InboxFamily account.

If you run the family's domain, you can ask ChatGPT to show the mailboxes and shared addresses, add a mailbox, change a name or role, add or remove a shared address, and remove a mailbox after a clear warning and your confirmation. A panel inside ChatGPT shows the same screens as the InboxFamily panel.

If you have an InboxFamily mailbox, sign in with your email address and password and ChatGPT can find and read your messages, summarize them, move them to folders, archive them, mark them read, flagged or spam, and save a draft reply for you to review. Mail it moves can be moved back.

What it cannot do: it cannot send mail and it cannot delete mail for good. The mail server itself refuses both. It never sees or sets a password. It cannot buy, change or cancel a plan. It works only with accounts that already exist; new accounts are made on inboxfamily.com.

What ChatGPT reads in your mailbox, it reads at your request, and you can disconnect it at any time in your webmail settings.
payload.longDescription:
InboxFamily在其自有域名下提供家庭电子邮件地址。此插件需要已有的InboxFamily账户才能使用。

如果您管理该家庭域名，可以要求ChatGPT展示邮箱和共享地址，添加邮箱、修改名称或角色、增删共享地址，并在明确警告并确认后删除邮箱。ChatGPT内的面板显示与InboxFamily相同的操作界面。

如果您拥有InboxFamily邮箱，通过邮箱地址和密码登录后，ChatGPT可为您查找并阅读邮件，生成摘要，移动至文件夹、归档、标记已读/星标/垃圾邮件，并保存草稿供您审阅。已移动的邮件可以撤销操作。

它无法执行以下操作：发送邮件或永久删除邮件。邮件服务器本身均拒绝这些操作。它不会查看或设置密码，也无法购买、更改或取消订阅计划。该插件仅支持已存在的账户；新账户需在inboxfamily.com创建。

ChatGPT读取您邮箱内容均基于您的主动请求，您可在网页邮箱设置中随时断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search and read your email, Sort, archive and flag messages, Save draft replies, Manage family mailboxes, Manage shared addresses, Interactive panel

payload.name: MailReach
payload.description: 让您的邮件远离垃圾邮件
payload.summaryOriginal: Keep your emails out of spam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MailReach is an email deliverability tool for teams that send sales, outreach and marketing emails. It warms up sending mailboxes, monitors their reputation and runs spam tests, so emails land in the inbox instead of the spam folder. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your MailReach project so you can check and improve your deliverability in plain language, without opening the dashboard.

What you can do:
- See how your mailboxes are doing: reputation score, inbox and spam rates, SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks, and open alerts.
- Follow your inbox rate over time, for the whole project or one mailbox.
- Check an email draft for spam words, risky links and images before you send it. Nothing is sent.
- Run a spam test and see where your email landed at Gmail, Outlook and other providers.
- When a test lands in spam, let Autofix find what in the email triggers the filters and suggest a reviewed rewrite.
- Pause or resume a mailbox, change its warming settings, organise mailboxes with tags and set up Slack or webhook alerts.

ChatGPT only reaches the one MailReach project you pick when you connect, with the permissions of your role on it. Removing a mailbox always asks for your confirmation first. New mailboxes are connected on the MailReach dashboard, so you never paste a password in the chat.

A MailReach account is required. Sign in with your MailReach email and password.
payload.longDescription:
MailReach是为发送销售、推广和营销邮件的团队设计的邮件投递工具。它可激活发送邮箱、监控声誉并运行垃圾邮件测试，确保邮件进入收件箱而非垃圾邮件文件夹。此插件将ChatGPT连接到您的MailReach项目，您可通过自然语言检查并改进投递效果，无需打开仪表盘。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 查看邮箱状态：声誉评分、收件箱和垃圾邮件率、SPF、DKIM和DMARC检查，以及打开警报。
- 跟踪整体项目或单个邮箱的收件箱率变化。
- 在发送前检查邮件草稿中的垃圾邮件词汇、风险链接和图片。
不会发送任何内容。
- 运行垃圾邮件测试，查看邮件在Gmail、Outlook及其他服务商中的归属。
- 当测试结果落入垃圾邮件时，让Autofix分析邮件中触发过滤器的内容并建议修改方案。
- 暂停或恢复邮箱、调整激活设置、通过标签整理邮箱，并配置Slack或网络钩子警报。

连接时ChatGPT仅访问您选择的MailReach项目，并受您在该项目中的角色权限限制。
移除邮箱前会先要求确认。
新邮箱需在MailReach仪表盘中连接，您无需在聊天中输入密码。

需要MailReach账户。
使用您的MailReach邮箱和密码登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check mailbox reputation, Run spam tests, Check email content, Fix emails that land in spam, Manage mailbox warming

payload.name: Easy Email Verification
payload.description: 验证电子邮件，减少退信
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Easy Email Verification is an email address verification tool for ChatGPT. It checks whether email addresses exist and whether they are risky to send to, before you send a message or a campaign.

Sending to addresses that do not exist causes bounces, and a high bounce rate can hurt your sender reputation. Verifying addresses first helps you remove the ones that are likely to bounce.

What you can do:
- Verify one email address, or up to 50 addresses at once.
- Verify lists of up to 10,000 addresses. ChatGPT starts the job, checks its progress and shows you a summary of the results. The full results file is available in your Easy Email Verification dashboard.
- Get a "did you mean" suggestion when an address looks like a typo, for example someone@gmial.com.
- Check your remaining verification credits.
- Delete a bulk job and its results when you no longer need them.

Each result says whether the address is valid, invalid or unknown, with the reason and a "safe to send" recommendation. It also shows risk signals: disposable address, role address (like info@ or sales@), free email provider and accept-all domain. "Unknown" means the mail server did not allow a reliable conclusion.

Useful for marketers checking a list before a campaign, sales teams checking leads before importing them into a CRM, and anyone who wants to confirm an address before sending an important email.

Sign in with your Easy Email Verification account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Easy Email Verification 是专为 ChatGPT 设计的电子邮件地址验证工具。在发送消息或活动前，它可以检测电子邮件地址是否存在，以及是否适合发送。

向不存在的地址发送内容会导致退信，高退信率会损害您的发件人声誉。提前验证地址可帮助您移除可能造成退信的无效地址。

您可以：
- 验证单个电子邮件地址，或一次最多验证 50 个地址。
- 验证最多包含 10,000 个地址的列表。
ChatGPT 将启动任务、显示进度并为您提供结果摘要。
完整结果文件可在您的 Easy Email Verification 仪表盘中查看。
- 当地址看起来像拼写错误时（例如 someone@gmial.com），会提供「您是指」的建议。
- 查看剩余验证积分。
- 在不再需要时删除批量任务及其结果。

每个验证结果会标明地址是否有效、无效或未知，并附带原因和「是否可安全发送」的建议。同时会显示风险信号：临时地址、角色地址（如 info@ 或 sales@）、免费邮箱服务商和接受所有邮件的域名。「未知」表示邮件服务器未允许得出可靠结论。

适用于营销人员在活动前检查地址列表、销售团队在导入 CRM 前核查潜在客户，以及任何希望在发送重要邮件前确认地址准确性的人士。

通过您的 Easy Email Verification 账户登录即可开始使用。

payload.name: Emailit
payload.description: 发送电子邮件并运行营销活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Emailit is an email delivery platform for transactional email, SMTP and email marketing. This plugin lets ChatGPT and Codex work with your Emailit account: send transactional email from your verified sending domains, check whether a message was delivered, opened or clicked, and find out why an email bounced or was marked as spam.

You can also add and verify sending domains with step-by-step DNS help, manage contacts, audiences, suppressions and templates, draft and send marketing campaigns, run automations, verify email lists, and set up webhooks.

Sign in with your Emailit account and choose which workspaces to allow: all of them, or only the ones you select. Tools that send email or delete data are marked so ChatGPT and Codex ask you before running them. Codex users also get skills for integrating the Emailit API and SDKs into their code.
payload.longDescription:
Emailit是一个事务邮件、SMTP和邮件营销的电子邮件投递平台。此插件使ChatGPT和Codex能够与您的Emailit账户协作：从已验证的发件域名发送事务邮件，检查邮件是否已送达、打开或被点击，并查明邮件退信或被标记为垃圾邮件的原因。

您还可以通过逐步DNS指导添加和验证发件域名，管理联系人、受众群体、屏蔽列表和模板，撰写并发送营销活动，运行自动化流程，验证邮件列表，并设置网络钩子。

使用您的Emailit账户登录并选择允许的工作区：全部工作区或您选择的特定工作区。发送邮件或删除数据的工具会进行标注，因此ChatGPT和Codex在运行前会向您确认。Codex用户还可获得将Emailit API和SDK集成到代码中的功能。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Send and schedule email, Track delivery and bounces, Set up and verify domains, Manage contacts and audiences, Draft and send campaigns, Configure webhooks

payload.name: Kreatoai
payload.description: 一键发布到所有社交媒体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kreatoai lets you publish and schedule social media posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, right from your conversation.

Connect your accounts once on kreatoai.com, then ask in plain language:
• Write a post and publish it now, or schedule it for a precise date and time
• Send the same post to several accounts at once, including several Pages or profiles on the same network
• Attach an image or a video from a public link, or send it from your phone or computer through a secure upload link
• See what is scheduled, check whether a post went out and get its link
• Move, edit or cancel a scheduled post before it goes out
• Prepare a whole week or month of posts in a single conversation

You confirm before anything is published or cancelled. The assistant only accesses your Kreatoai workspace: never your passwords, your social network tokens, your private messages or your payment details.

Good to know
• Instagram, TikTok and YouTube need an image or a video with each post. Facebook and LinkedIn also accept text only.
• A Kreatoai account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Kreatoai 让您能够直接通过对话在 Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn 和 YouTube 上发布和安排社交媒体帖子。

在 kreatoai.com 上一次性连接您的账户，然后用自然语言提出需求：
• 撰写并立即发布帖子，或安排在特定日期和时间发布
• 一次性将同一帖子发送到多个账户，包括同一平台上的多个页面或个人资料
• 通过公开链接添加图片或视频，或通过安全上传链接从手机或电脑发送
• 查看已安排的内容，确认帖子是否已发布并获取链接
• 在帖子发布前修改、编辑或取消已安排的帖子
• 在一次对话中即可提前准备一周或一个月的全部内容

任何内容发布或取消前都需要您确认。
助理仅能访问您的 Kreatoai 工作区：不会获取您的密码、社交网络令牌、私信或支付信息。

注意事项
• Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 每条帖子都需要配图或视频。
Facebook 和 LinkedIn 也支持纯文本帖子。
• 需要 Kreatoai 账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Publish posts now, Schedule posts, Check whether a post went out, Edit or cancel scheduled posts, Attach images and videos

payload.name: ChatifyIT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Write your LinkedIn posts, announcements and newsletter emails in ChatGPT and save them as drafts in ChatifyIT, ready for you to review, schedule and send. ChatifyIT is a link-in-bio page for creators and founders, with an Emails & Posts page where all your drafts wait for you.

With the ChatifyIT plugin, ChatGPT can:
- Write a LinkedIn post, a release announcement or a newsletter email with you, using your ChatifyIT name, bio and brand details, and save it as a draft on your Emails & Posts page.
- Write a LinkedIn post from a video you uploaded to ChatifyIT, using what you actually say in it, and attach the video to the draft.
- Add an image or video from your chat to a saved draft.
- Set up Instagram comment words that send people what they asked for (when Instagram is connected).
- Check your connection and list the drafts you already saved.

Nothing is posted or sent from ChatGPT. You review every draft on chatifyit.com/emails-posts, edit it, and post it to LinkedIn or send it to your email list yourself, now or on a schedule.

ChatifyIT can't see your leads, your visitors' emails, payments or password through this plugin. A ChatifyIT account is required.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中撰写你的领英帖子、公告和新闻通讯邮件，并保存为ChatifyIT草稿，即可随时查看、安排发布或发送。ChatifyIT是创作者和创始人的简介链接页面，包含邮件与帖子页面，所有草稿都在这里等待你处理。

通过ChatifyIT插件，ChatGPT可以：
- 与你协作撰写领英帖子、发布公告或新闻通讯邮件，使用你的ChatifyIT名称、简介和品牌信息，将内容保存到你的邮件与帖子页面。
- 从你上传到ChatifyIT的视频中生成领英帖子，直接使用视频中的实际内容，并将视频附加到草稿中。
- 将聊天中的图片或视频添加到已保存的草稿中。
- 设置Instagram评论关键词，当连接Instagram时可自动发送用户所需内容。
- 检查连接状态并列出你已保存的草稿。

ChatGPT不会直接发布或发送任何内容。
你需在chatifyit.com/emails-posts页面审核每个草稿，进行编辑后，自行将内容发布到领英或发送至邮件列表，可立即操作或安排发布时间。

通过此插件，ChatifyIT无法查看你的潜在客户、访客邮箱、付款信息或密码。
需要拥有ChatifyIT账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Save LinkedIn post drafts, Save newsletter email drafts, Write posts from your uploaded videos, Add images or videos from the chat to a draft, Set up Instagram comment words, List your saved drafts

payload.name: Openline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Openline is a communication plugin. A signed-in chat sends and reads email, places and reviews phone calls, and sends and reads SMS from an inbox and a US phone number that Openline provides. It uses only the inbox and number on the account you connect. It does not read another person's inbox, send bulk unsolicited messages, or take a sign-in code in chat. Sign-in happens on Openline's page.
payload.longDescription: Openline 是一款通信插件。通过登录的聊天界面，用户可以发送和阅读电子邮件、拨打电话并查看电话记录，以及通过Openline提供的收件箱和美国电话号码发送和接收短信。它仅使用您所连接账户的收件箱和电话号码。它不会读取他人收件箱、发送群发垃圾信息，或在聊天中获取登录验证码。登录操作在Openline的页面上完成。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Send email, Read email, Place calls, Send SMS, Read SMS

payload.name: PieterPost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Send your words as physical mail without creating a PieterPost account. PieterPost prints and posts letters and postcards to the postal address you provide. Draft correspondence, check postage, upload a photo or PDF, and get an editable preview or a secure checkout link. Review and pay on PieterPost’s website before printing and posting. Check payment and fulfillment status using the order reference returned by the plugin. Saved contacts, account history, wallets, and API-key management are unavailable in this guest plugin.
payload.longDescription: 无需创建PieterPost账户即可发送实体邮件。PieterPost会将信件和明信片打印并邮寄至您提供的邮政地址。撰写信件、查看邮费、上传照片或PDF，并获取可编辑预览或安全结账链接。在打印和邮寄前通过PieterPost网站审核并支付。使用插件返回的订单参考号查看支付和履行状态。已保存联系人、账户历史记录、钱包及API密钥管理功能在该访客插件中不可用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Prepare letters and postcards, Quote postage, Create guest checkout links, Track a mail order

payload.name: Wittle Rooms
payload.description: 你的代理人在这里相遇
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wittle Rooms is a chat room for two AI agents. Your agent creates a room with a goal, such as finding a dinner time with a friend, and shares an invite link. The other person's agent joins with its owner's approval. The two agents message each other in the room, agree on an outcome, and either of you can export the shared transcript.

Each agent uses only its own owner's tools and permissions, and shares only what the conversation needs. Messages from the other agent are treated as information, never as instructions. In supported ChatGPT Work chats your agent listens automatically after creating or joining a room, so it replies when a new message arrives; replies are limited per room and you can stop listening at any time.

Rooms does not book, pay, or contact anyone outside the room. Rooms accept new messages for 24 hours. Shared transcripts are stored until deleted on request and are not end-to-end encrypted.
payload.longDescription:
Wittle Rooms 是一个由两个 AI 代理人使用的聊天室。
你的代理人在设定目标后（例如与朋友商定晚餐时间）会创建一个房间，并分享邀请链接。
对方代理人在获得其拥有者批准后加入房间。
两个代理人可在房间内互相发送消息、达成一致结果，你们任一方均可导出共享对话记录。

每个代理人仅使用其拥有者提供的工具和权限，并且仅分享对话所需的信息。
来自对方代理人的消息仅被视为信息内容，不会被当作指令处理。
在支持的 ChatGPT Work 聊天中，你的代理人创建或加入房间后会自动监听新消息，当有新消息时会自动回复；每个房间的回复次数有限制，且你可以随时停止监听。

Rooms 不会处理房间外的预订、支付或联系操作。
房间会接受持续24小时的新消息。
共享对话记录会保存至用户主动删除，且不采用端到端加密方式。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create rooms, Join with owner approval, Exchange shared messages, Agree on an outcome, Export shared transcripts

payload.name: mailmcp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
mailmcp connects ChatGPT to mailboxes you configure: Gmail, Outlook.com and Microsoft 365, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo, Zoho or any IMAP/SMTP account, several at once. Ask it to find a message, summarize a thread, pull the amount from an invoice PDF, draft a reply in the right thread, file mail into folders, sort what needs a reply, or give you a digest since yesterday.

Safe by default: each mailbox has its own permissions (read, drafts, send, move, trash). Sending is off unless the owner turns it on, and then goes only to addresses on the owner's allowlist. Nothing is ever deleted permanently; bulk actions run in two steps, a preview of the exact messages and then only those. Every email body is handed to ChatGPT marked as untrusted content, so ChatGPT can treat instructions hidden in mail as data rather than commands; sending and bulk changes still need the owner's settings and a preview.

You sign in with a token you create on mailmcp.ai/setup. Mailbox passwords stay inside that encrypted token; the server stores no mail and no credentials. Outlook uses Microsoft's own sign-in, with no password at all. Follow-ups, snoozes and templates are kept in your own mailbox, never on our server.

Where ChatGPT shows app panels, the triage list, the digest and a draft card appear as a panel. The panel loads nothing from the internet, and each of its buttons is an ordinary tool call that the server checks exactly like the assistant's own.

Limitations: the quick search across all mailboxes looks in the Outlook Inbox and in Gmail All Mail (ask for a folder to look elsewhere), and files uploaded through a link are limited to about 4.5 MB.

payload.longDescription: 连接 Free Law Project 的法律研究平台 CourtListener，即可访问数百万份美国法院判决、PACER 案件档案、法官资料、口头辩论记录和引证数据。搜索联邦及州法院判例法，获取完整案件元数据，从权威数据库中提取并核验法律引证，并为新判决或案件档案更新设置提醒。CourtListener 由 Free Law Project 创建并运营；该组织是致力于让公众广泛获取法律信息的 501(c)(3) 非营利机构。适合法律从业者、法律研究人员、记者、学者和自行诉讼当事人快速可靠地访问一手法律资料。

payload.name: Wayground
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wayground helps teachers and students turn teaching and learning materials into ready-to-assign quizzes and study cards. Paste or reference instructional content, and Wayground generates aligned questions and flashcards directly from it — no need to rewrite lessons as assessments. Teachers use it to save prep time and quickly check understanding. Students use it to practice and self-check from the same material. Generated activities are delivered through Wayground, with reporting so teachers can see how students are engaging and where they need support.
payload.longDescription: Wayground 帮助教师和学生将教学与学习材料转化为可直接布置的测验和学习卡片。粘贴或引用教学内容，Wayground 就会据此生成相匹配的问题和单词卡，无需把课程内容重新改写成考题。教师可以节省备课时间，并快速检查学生是否理解；学生则可以用同一份材料练习和自测。生成的学习活动通过 Wayground 发布，并附有报告，让教师了解学生的参与情况以及他们需要帮助的地方。

payload.name: Transkriptor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transkriptor brings your transcription library into ChatGPT.

Work with the transcripts and recordings already in your Transkriptor account—
list them, read the full text, get AI-generated summaries, download as PDF, 
and check your account details, all from a chat conversation.

Key features:

- Browse transcripts: List and filter your transcriptions by file name keyword, 
  date range, or duration.
- Read full transcripts: Fetch the complete transcript content, including 
  speaker labels and timestamps.
- AI summaries: Get concise, structured summaries of meetings, interviews, 
  lectures, podcasts, and other recorded content.
- PDF export: Generate a downloadable PDF of any transcript.
- Account overview: Check remaining transcription minutes, subscription plan, 
  and language preference.

To create new transcriptions, use Transkriptor on the web (transkriptor.com), 
iOS, or Android. Once a transcription exists in your account, this connector 
makes it easy to find, read, summarize, and share through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Transkriptor 将你的转录资料库带入 ChatGPT。

在聊天中即可处理 Transkriptor 账户中已有的转录文本和录音——列出文件、阅读全文、获取 AI 生成的摘要、下载 PDF，并查看账户详情。

主要功能：

- 浏览转录文件：按文件名关键词、日期范围或时长列出并筛选转录内容。
- 阅读完整转录：获取完整转录内容，包括说话人标签和时间戳。
- AI 摘要：为会议、访谈、讲座、播客和其他录音生成简洁、有条理的摘要。
- 导出 PDF：为任意转录文本生成可下载的 PDF。
- 账户概览：查看剩余转录分钟数、订阅方案和语言偏好。

如需创建新的转录，请在网页端 (transkriptor.com)、iOS 或 Android 上使用 Transkriptor。转录内容保存到账户后，此连接器便可让你通过 ChatGPT 轻松查找、阅读、总结和分享。

payload.name: MetaMetrics® Lexile Analyzer
payload.description: 生成 Lexile 文本难度量值
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Measure the complexity of any text and receive its Lexile® measure in seconds. You can also use AI-powered text adaptation to increase or decrease the text’s complexity while preserving its meaning, helping you create versions that are more accessible or more challenging for different readers.
payload.longDescription: 只需几秒钟即可测量任意文本的复杂程度并获得其 Lexile® 量值。你还可以使用 AI 文本改写功能，在保留原意的同时提高或降低文本复杂度，为不同读者创建更易读或更具挑战性的版本。

payload.name: Language Coach: English
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LangCoach helps you check your English level with a placement test and see your CEFR band (A1–C1). Open the app in chat to take the test, review your score breakdown, and keep your level saved to your account. More practice modes are coming soon.
payload.longDescription: LangCoach 可通过分级测试检查你的英语水平，并显示对应的 CEFR 等级（A1–C1）。在聊天中打开应用参加测试、查看分数明细，并将等级保存到你的账户。更多练习模式即将推出。

payload.name: Elicit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Elicit's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically. Built for life sciences R&D workflows, the server enables agents to rapidly survey evidence, compare findings across studies, and surface key data points without manual literature review, accelerating everything from target discovery to systematic evidence assessment.
payload.longDescription: Elicit 的 MCP 服务器让 AI 助手能够直接访问包含超过 125 百万篇学术论文的语料库。使用自然语言查询搜索相关文献，创建跨论文提取和综合数据的结构化报告，并以编程方式检索详细报告结果。该服务器面向生命科学研发工作流，让代理能够快速梳理证据、比较研究发现并提取关键数据点，无需人工逐篇审查，从而加快从靶点发现到系统性证据评估的各项工作。

payload.name: Legal Data Hunter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Legal Data Hunter connects ChatGPT to the world's fastest-growing open legal corpus — a continuously-updated index of 32M+ documents from 180+ jurisdictions. LDH ingests directly from official registries — Légifrance, BOE, EUR-Lex, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and hundreds more — and exposes them through a focused tool surface: hybrid semantic + keyword search, citation resolution (ECLI, CELEX, case numbers, article references with 95% accuracy across 184 sources), full-text retrieval, and discovery tools that tell the assistant what we have for a jurisdiction before it queries.

Free tier covers 20 searches/day for punctual research needs; paid plans scale to 100,000/month. Used by lawyers, paralegals, and legal-tech builders worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
Legal Data Hunter 将 ChatGPT 连接到全球增长最快的开放法律语料库之一——持续更新的索引包含来自 180+ 个司法辖区的 32M+ 份文档。LDH 直接从官方登记机构（包括 Légifrance、BOE、EUR-Lex、RIS、Bundesgerichtshof、欧洲人权法院等数百个来源）采集数据，并通过专门的工具提供混合语义与关键词搜索、引证解析（在 184 个来源中对 ECLI、CELEX、案号和条款引文的准确率为 95%）、全文检索，以及查询前先了解某个司法辖区有哪些资料的发现工具。

免费套餐每天可进行 20 次搜索，适用于临时研究需求；付费套餐最高支持每月 100,000 次搜索。全球律师、律师助理和法律科技开发者都在使用。

payload.name: Self Plagiarism Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker opens an interactive widget where users can paste two documents and identify repeated phrase combinations. It highlights matching phrases of four or more consecutive words, shows a similarity percentage, and lists matched phrase combinations for quick writing review. Pasted text is processed inside the widget UI and is not stored by the MCP server.
payload.longDescription: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker 会打开一个交互式 widget，用户可以粘贴两份文档并识别重复的短语组合。它会高亮显示连续四个或更多单词相同的短语，显示相似度百分比，并列出匹配的短语组合，便于快速检查写作内容。粘贴的文本在 widget 界面内处理，不会由 MCP 服务器存储。

payload.name: Strive PDF Generator
payload.description: 将 LaTeX 转为 PDF 和数学练习册
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, edit, and download professional PDFs with graphs and math notation — all without leaving ChatGPT.
Describe what you need in plain language or use the built-in LaTeX editor, then download the final PDF instantly.

Example Prompts
  • Teachers:
"Create a quadratic equations worksheet PDF with 10 questions and include an answer key."
  • Parents:
"Here is my daughter's math exam. Create a math worksheet PDF with questions targeting her growth areas."
  • Students:
"Create a mock IB Physics exam PDF focused on kinematics."
  • Professors:
"Format this abstract and introduction into a two-column IEEE-style PDF with citation placeholders."
  • Professionals:
"Create a PDF résumé based on the following LinkedIn data."
  • Developers:
"Compile this LaTeX code and generate a polished PDF."

No more copying LaTeX into external tools. Edit, recompile, and refine PDFs entirely within ChatGPT. Advanced users can open the PDF in full screen to manually edit and recompile the LaTeX — all in one place.

Key Features
  • Natural language input – Just describe what you want to create
  • LaTeX-powered formatting – Clean, professional math notation
  • Instant PDF generation – Download your PDF in seconds
  • Flexible viewing options – Full-screen, distraction-free PDF and LaTeX view
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建、编辑和下载带有图表与数学符号的专业 PDF。
用日常语言描述需求，或使用内置的 LaTeX 编辑器，然后立即下载最终 PDF。

示例提示
  • 教师：
“创建一份包含 10 道题并附答案的二次方程练习册 PDF。”
  • 家长：
“这是我女儿的数学考试。请创建一份针对她需要提升的部分设计题目的数学练习册 PDF。”
  • 学生：
“创建一份聚焦运动学的 IB 物理模拟考试 PDF。”
  • 教授：
“把这份摘要和引言排版成双栏 IEEE 风格的 PDF，并预留引文占位符。”
  • 专业人士：
“根据以下 LinkedIn 数据制作一份 PDF 简历。”
  • 开发者：
“编译这段 LaTeX 代码并生成精美的 PDF。”

无需再把 LaTeX 复制到外部工具。在 ChatGPT 中即可完成 PDF 的编辑、重新编译和润色。高级用户可以全屏打开 PDF，手动编辑并重新编译 LaTeX，所有操作都在同一处完成。

主要功能
  • 自然语言输入 – 只需描述你想创建的内容
  • LaTeX 驱动的排版 – 清晰、专业的数学符号
  • 即时生成 PDF – 几秒钟即可下载 PDF
  • 灵活的查看方式 – 全屏、无干扰的 PDF 和 LaTeX 视图

payload.name: Midpage Legal Research: US Law
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to an enterprise-grade database of case law, statutes, regulations, dockets, and more to enable complex legal research and writing workflows inside of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 连接至包含判例法、法规、规章、案件档案等的企业级数据库，支持在ChatGPT内开展复杂的法律研究和写作工作流程。

payload.name: alphaXiv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: alphaXiv helps users discover academic papers, read and query paper content, inspect linked GitHub repositories, and manage folders of saved papers through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: alphaXiv 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 发现学术论文，阅读和查询论文内容，查看关联的 GitHub 仓库，并管理已保存论文的文件夹。

payload.name: AnyLessonPlan for Teachers
payload.description: 为学校和班级生成教学内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AnyLessonPlan is a simple easy tool to help ChatGPT generate lesson plans!

e.g.

- "@AnyLessonPlan, I need to teach number bonds to my Grade 1 class"
- "Use @AnyLessonPlan to prepare a lesson on short story writing for my 12 year old class"

or, upload your lesson plan and ask

"This needs to be 20m shorter. Use @AnyLessonPlan"
payload.longDescription:
AnyLessonPlan 是一款简单易用的工具，帮助 ChatGPT 生成教案！

例如：

- “@AnyLessonPlan，我需要教 1 年级学生学习数的分解与组合”
- “使用 @AnyLessonPlan 为我的 12 岁学生准备一堂短篇小说写作课”

或者上传教案，然后提出请求

“这需要缩短 20m。使用 @AnyLessonPlan”

payload.name: Audioscrape
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transcribe any recording, or search millions of moments from podcasts, city-council and county meetings, and Supreme Court hearings — with new episodes and meetings added every day.

Attach an audio file in the chat, or paste a direct link or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link, and get a private, speaker-attributed transcript you can question. Every recording you add goes into your own workspace, where the people, companies, and topics in it are linked into a knowledge graph — so the tenth recording is searchable alongside the first.

Ask what was said about anything and get answers with the speaker, the exact timestamp, and a link that jumps to the moment. Track what any person, company, or topic has said across every episode and every recording of your own.
payload.longDescription:
转写任何录音，或搜索播客、市议会及县级会议、最高法院听证中的数百万个片段——每天都有新节目和会议加入。

在聊天中附加音频文件，或粘贴直接链接、Google Drive、Dropbox 或 OneDrive 分享链接，即可获得标注说话人的私密转写文本，并针对内容提问。你添加的每段录音都会进入自己的工作区，其中的人物、公司和主题会关联成知识图谱——因此第十段录音可以与第一段一起搜索。

询问任何话题曾被如何讨论，获得包含说话人、精确时间戳及直达对应时刻链接的答案。追踪任何人物、公司或主题在每集节目以及你自己的每段录音中的相关发言。

payload.name: StudyMe.ai
payload.description: 教育：用 1 个链接授课
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StudyMe.ai turns your teaching ideas into interactive lessons in seconds.
It is completely free to create and share lessons with students. Tell StudyMe.ai what you want to teach — including topic, level, and goal — and it creates a ready-to-use lesson webpage your students can open from a single link.
Teachers can easily refine each lesson by prompting ChatGPT or by adjusting the final result with editing tools on StudyMe.ai.
Students learn actively through quizzes, calculations, drag-and-drop exercises, clear explanations, and instant positive feedback. The varied tasks help increase engagement, improve focus, and support deeper learning.
Lessons can be shared instantly via unique links, with no login required for students.
Ideal for teachers, tutors, and educators who want to create high-quality lessons quickly and easily.
payload.longDescription:
StudyMe.ai 可以在几秒钟内把你的教学构想变成互动课程。
创建课程并与学生分享完全免费。告诉 StudyMe.ai 你想教什么，包括主题、级别和目标，它就会生成一个可直接使用的课程网页，学生通过一个链接即可打开。
教师可以通过向 ChatGPT 提示来轻松完善课程，也可以使用 StudyMe.ai 的编辑工具调整最终结果。
学生通过测验、计算、拖放练习、清晰讲解和即时积极反馈主动学习。多样化的任务有助于提高参与度、增强专注力并促进深入学习。
课程可通过专属链接即时分享，学生无需登录。
非常适合希望快速创建高质量课程的教师、辅导老师和教育工作者。

payload.name: Wiley Scholar Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wiley Scholar Gateway enables ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector searches literature from Wiley journals to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata. This enables you to verify that claims are backed with sourced research — ensuring your research meets professional research standards.
payload.longDescription: Wiley Scholar Gateway 让 ChatGPT 能够根据经过同行评审的来源生成回答，并提供可验证的引文和 DOI 链接。Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector 会搜索 Wiley 期刊文献，提供有证据支持的答案和完整来源元数据。借此，你可以核实各项说法是否有来源研究支持，确保研究符合专业标准。

payload.name: Academic Writing Toolkit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Academic Writing Toolkit helps users review pasted academic writing materials in ChatGPT. It can audit citation consistency between draft prose and reading-note source lines, check conservative British English spelling, flag paragraph-level logic issues, validate BibTeX records offline, and create a standard reading-notes Markdown template.
payload.longDescription: Academic Writing Toolkit 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中审阅粘贴的学术写作材料。它可以核查草稿正文与阅读笔记来源条目之间的引用一致性、检查传统英式英语拼写、标记段落层面的逻辑问题、离线验证 BibTeX 记录，并创建标准阅读笔记 Markdown 模板。

payload.name: Sider Scholar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your AI Research Assistant lets you search 350M+ research papers, chat with large volumes of research PDFs, and save findings to your Wisebase (knowledge base).

1. Global Academic Search (Search & Read)
- Major Sources: Search 350M+ papers from Google Scholar, PubMed, arXiv, and more.
- Read Instantly: Access full papers instantly to verify findings.

2. Build Your Knowledge Base (Save & Collect)
- Save for Continuous Research: Save searched papers to Wisebase for continuous questioning and deep analysis of your findings.
- Save Chat History: Save key research discussions as editable documents to capture and refine insights.

3. Unified Knowledge Analysis (Agentic RAG)
- Chat with Your Collection: Analyze your entire collection simultaneously.
- Traceable Sources: Get grounded answers with precise Reference Indices to verify every claim.

4. Visual Knowledge Organization (Visualize & Explore)
- Knowledge Graphing: Instantly generate interactive graphs from any paper to explore definitions, cause-and-effect links, and concept hierarchies.

Ideal Use Cases: For researchers, PhD students, and academics who need to access massive academic sources and synthesize grounded arguments with precise citations.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Sider Scholar to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Sider Scholar".

Sample Prompts
- Search Paper: “@Sider Scholar Search recent papers on 'LLM alignment' published in the last two years.”
- Chat with Knowledge Base: “@Sider Scholar Answer questions about 'CRISPR gene editing' using my Knowledge Base.”
- Visual Research: “@Sider Scholar Build a Knowledge Graph explaining key concepts in 'Reinforcement Learning'.”
payload.longDescription:
您的AI研究助手可搜索3.5亿+篇学术论文，与大量研究PDF进行对话，并将发现保存至您的Wisebase（知识库）中。

1.
全球学术搜索（搜索与阅读）
- 主要来源：从Google Scholar、PubMed、arXiv等平台搜索3.5亿+篇论文。
- 即时阅读：可立即访问完整论文以验证研究结果。

2.
构建知识库（保存与收集）
- 保存用于持续研究：将搜索到的论文保存至Wisebase，实现对研究发现的持续提问与深度分析。
- 保存对话记录：将关键研究讨论保存为可编辑文档，捕捉并提炼洞察结论。

3.
统一知识分析（智能体RAG）
- 与您的资料库对话：可同时分析整个资料库内容。
- 可追溯来源：通过精准的参考文献索引获取有依据的答案，验证每个主张的出处。

4.
可视化知识组织（可视化与探索）
- 知识图谱：可从任意论文即时生成交互式图表，探索定义、因果关系及概念层级。

理想应用场景：适用于需要访问海量学术资源并基于精确引用合成实证论点的研究人员、博士生及学术工作者。

在ChatGPT中使用方法
1.
连接应用：将Sider Scholar与ChatGPT连接。
2.
触发指令：输入“@Sider Scholar”。

示例提示
- 搜索论文："@Sider Scholar 搜索过去两年内发表的关于'LLM对齐'的最新论文。"
- 与知识库聊天："@Sider Scholar 使用我的知识库回答有关'CRISPR基因编辑'的问题。"
- 视觉研究："@Sider Scholar 构建一个知识图谱，解释'强化学习'中的关键概念。"

payload.name: quran.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your AI-powered Quran study companion — trace themes across all 114 surahs, compare how classical and modern scholars interpret the same verse, unpack the depth and precision behind the Quran's eloquence, and contextualize difficult passages with real, authentic tafsir commentary. All data sourced from quran.com, so every verse, scholarly opinion, interpretation, and linguistic detail the AI cites is verified — not guessed from training data.
payload.longDescription: 将ChatGPT转化为你的AI驱动《古兰经》学习伙伴——追踪全部114章的主旨脉络，对比古典与现代学者对同一经文的解读，解析《古兰经》修辞背后的深度与精准性，并通过真实可靠的经注阐释理解疑难章节。所有数据均源自quran.com，因此AI引用的每句经文、学术观点、解释内容及语言细节均经过验证——而非基于训练数据的推测。

payload.name: Udemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Learn skills that move you forward with the Udemy app in ChatGPT. With Udemy, you can turn your curiosity, questions, and “I need to figure this out” moments into real progress.

Just tell ChatGPT what you want to learn, and the Udemy app helps you discover courses and video previews from real-world experts. Explore what skills you can learn, how the course is structured, and if it fits your goals — before diving in.

Millions of learners around the world use Udemy to build practical skills for work and life. Now, finding the right course happens where learning begins, so you can keep moving forward.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 Udemy 应用，学习能助你不断进步的技能。使用 Udemy，你可以把好奇心、问题以及“我得弄明白这件事”的时刻转化为切实进步。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 你想学什么，Udemy 应用就会帮你发现课程和真实领域专家的视频预览。了解可以学习哪些技能、课程结构如何，以及课程是否符合你的目标，然后再开始学习。

全球数百万学习者通过 Udemy 培养工作和生活所需的实用技能。现在，你可以在学习开始的地方找到合适课程，继续向前迈进。

payload.name: Music Block
payload.description: 创作乐谱与吉他谱 TAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Music Block turns music ideas in ChatGPT into playable sheet music and TAB.

Ask for guitar licks, piano voicings, bass lines, drum grooves, melodies, chord progressions, exercises, arrangements, or music theory examples, and Music Block renders them as engraved notation directly in the conversation.

Try prompts like “give me 5 melodic minor licks over B7alt,” “write a walking bass line over a ii–V–I,” “show me jazz piano voicings with smooth voice leading,” or “arrange this melody for string quartet.”
